---
title: "‘Bubble’ Collectibles"
date: "2005-11-29"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

The contrarian in me thinks that when ‘bubbles’ have become [collectible kitsch](http://www.elliottwave.com/store/gifts/bubbles/default.aspx?code=oco "collectible kitsch"), we are well beyond the point of having to take alleged asset price ‘bubbles’ seriously!
